workload_lunch_minutes_007.evidence: All teachers shall have an uninterrupted, duty-free lunch period of at least 30 minutes daily, not counting passing time, except for teachers with assigned lunch-time responsibilities.

workload_meetings_limits_008.evidence: Faculty meetings shall not exceed two per month, except when cleared by a School Leadership and Improvement Director in collaboration with the Executive Director of the Association and/or in the event of an emergency. Faculty meetings shall not exceed one per month beginning in the 2021-2022 school year.

workload_nonteaching_duties_009.evidence: Assigned supervisory duty, or other duty, shall not exceed 10 minutes in any lunch period. In order to assist in lunch-time supervisory duties, and to reduce and minimize the number of lunch-time duties for teachers, the District will budget an amount of money annually for lunch supervision programs.
